correctness.rationale: Apply the one-sided Hatori--Oi stability theorem to the map and its inverse. The compositions of the two linear cores differ from the identity by a uniformly bounded quantity on \(na\); linearity and division by \(n\) force both compositions to be the identity. The coordinate example follows from its two affine inverse branches.
